protocolContext.passive: Voltage clamp at -70 mV; -10 mV step. RMP at I=0.
protocolContext.ionic: Na/K voltage-step protocols; calcium voltage-step or ramp protocols. Individual sweep voltage is not attached to these summary rows.
protocolContext.receptor: Ligand responses at -80 mV. GABA 1 mM/30 ms; glycine 1 mM/100 ms; ACh 4 mM/500 ms; glutamate 100 µM/100–500 ms.
protocolContext.cavModulation: -80 mV holding, +10 mV/100 ms after -120 mV/50 ms. Source methods give baclofen 100 µM/40 s and oxotremorine-M 100 µM/50 s; Fig.12 caption gives 40 s for oxotremorine-M, retained as a protocol conflict.
protocolContext.ph: PKD2L1/ASIC current at -80 mV; spiking at RMP. Pressure application pH5/10 s or pH9/30 s. Raw NPo remains dimensionless; Perc is its source ×100 presentation column.

scope.unmappedReason: INa.xlsx is not referenced by the pinned ionic-current analysis script; the script uses InhNa.xlsx for inhibition. No synonym substitution.
scope.remainingDepositFiles: Other antagonist/subtype/normalized/statistics/anatomy files are outside these declared adapters; no claim of all-deposit cell coverage.

conflicts.detail: Native header Tau has no unit. The article reports µs; raw table scale is not assigned or converted by inference.
